title: Magnetic field expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for magnetic induction intensity B = mv₀/(qd).

title: Time expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for time in field t = 3πd/(4v₀).

title: Geometry of trajectory
description: Important: Identifies that the particle travels a circular arc of 135° (3π/4 rad) between entry and exit points.

title: Centripetal force setup
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law with Lorentz force: qvB = mv²/R, using the correct velocity magnitude.

title: Radius determination
description: Important: Uses geometric relationship (R sin(π/4) = d or equivalent) to relate radius R to given distance d.

title: Time calculation method
description: Important: Calculates time as arc length divided by speed, or using angular displacement divided by angular velocity.

title: Velocity magnitude error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect velocity magnitude (e.g., v₀ instead of √2v₀) in force or time equations.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong angular displacement (e.g., 90° instead of 135°) for arc length or time calculation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of final expressions for B and t.
